name: wodeappx
description: Open-source self-evolving AI desktop you build (WodeAppX): operable skills; best models for image & video; local-first

scripts.setup: pnpm openwork:bootstrap && pnpm openwork:patch && pnpm openwork:install
scripts.dev: WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss VITE_WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss pnpm openwork:patch && WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss VITE_WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss pnpm openwork:dev
scripts.dev:oss: WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss VITE_WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss pnpm openwork:patch && WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss VITE_WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss pnpm openwork:dev
scripts.dev:cloud: WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss VITE_WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss pnpm openwork:patch && pnpm openwork:patch-cloud && WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss VITE_WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss pnpm openwork:dev
scripts.build: WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss VITE_WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss pnpm openwork:patch && WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss VITE_WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss pnpm openwork:build
scripts.build:oss: WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss VITE_WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss pnpm openwork:patch && WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss VITE_WODEAPPX_EDITION=oss pnpm openwork:build
scripts.openwork:patch:test: node --test scripts/openwork-patch-text.test.mjs scripts/opencode-sidecar-version.test.mjs scripts/patch-opencode-dynamic-tools.test.mjs scripts/openwork-workspace-activation-patch.test.mjs scripts/openwork-electron-dev-patch.test.mjs scripts/filter-local-brand-agents.test.mjs scripts/pack-self-evolve-source.test.mjs scripts/self-evolve-guard-packaged-git.test.mjs scripts/wodeapp-self-evolve-source-bundle.test.mjs scripts/wodeapp-edition.test.mjs integrations/browser-control/tests/browser-agent-call.test.mjs integrations/openwork/fork/apps/desktop/electron/browser-native-host.test.mjs integrations/openwork/fork/apps/desktop/scripts/electron-after-pack.test.mjs integrations/openwork/fork/apps/desktop/electron/wodeapp-self-evolve-workspaces.test.mjs integrations/openwork/fork/apps/desktop/electron/wodeapp-supor-workspaces.test.mjs integrations/wodeapp-cloud/electron/login-bridge.test.mjs integrations/wodeapp-cloud/electron/wodeapp-local-runtime.test.mjs && node scripts/test-openwork-patch-idempotency.mjs
scripts.verify:source: pnpm open-source:check && node scripts/check-i18n-readiness.mjs && node --test scripts/oss-vps-verify.test.mjs
scripts.openwork:build: pnpm capture:build && cd vendor/openwork && VITE_DISABLE_OPENWORK_MODELS=1 pnpm build
scripts.openwork:dev: cd vendor/openwork && OPENWORK_DEV_MODE=1 VITE_DISABLE_OPENWORK_MODELS=1 pnpm dev
scripts.openwork:dev:local-sidecar: cd vendor/openwork && OPENWORK_DEV_MODE=1 VITE_DISABLE_OPENWORK_MODELS=1 OPENWORK_ELECTRON_SKIP_SHARED_PREPARE=1 pnpm dev
